mentions.name: Rapid BOD5 replacement test for wastewater
mentions.description: A faster and more accurate replacement for the BOD5 (Biochemical Oxygen Demand) 5-day test used in wastewater analysis.
mentions.problem: The standard BOD5 wastewater test requires a 5-day process and is slower and less accurate.
